tasks.requirement: Add ${NAME:+word} interpolation to python-dotenv: substitute word only when NAME resolves to a nonempty string; otherwise substitute an empty string. Apply this through dotenv_values and load_dotenv, preserving override precedence between earlier file values and the process environment. Keep the existing flat expression grammar: word ends at the first closing brace and is not recursively interpolated; do not add nested expansion or shell evaluation. Preserve existing ${NAME}, ${NAME:-default}, bare variables, adjacent substitutions, interpolate=False, unassigned keys and malformed-expression behavior. Do not change unrelated parsing or environment behavior.

tasks.requirement: Fix SpecifierSet.filter so its automatic prerelease policy considers the complete intersection: when no matching final or post release exists, return matching prereleases; an out-of-range final must not suppress them. When a matching final exists, suppress prereleases unless explicitly enabled. Preserve explicit True/False policies at both constructor and call levels, prerelease bounds, exclusions, empty sets, Version objects, original item identity, input order and duplicates. Accept one-shot iterables without restarting them. Preserve existing contains and individual Specifier comparison behavior.

tasks.requirement: On Unix, ignore relative XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME values and use their existing defaults. For XDG_DATA_DIRS and XDG_CONFIG_DIRS, discard empty and relative entries individually; if no absolute entries remain, use the existing defaults. Preserve absolute paths verbatim, including spaces, input order and duplicates. Keep app/version suffixes, multipath selection, Path wrappers, directory iterators and ensure_exists consistent. Never create a directory from a rejected relative value. Do not change runtime, media or non-Unix directory behavior.
